{
  "id": "mask-studio",
  "family": "mask-studio",
  "genre": "image",
  "label": "Mask",
  "description": "Selection-only mask card: RT-DETR proposes, SAM3 refines \u2192 named class masks for inpaint flows.",
  "source": {
    "type": "",
    "repo_id": "facebook/sam-vit-base"
  },
  "defaults": {
    "output_mode": "segm",
    "detect_mode": "body",
    "detection_threshold": 0.35,
    "sam_threshold": 0.93,
    "sam_dilation": 0,
    "export_face": false,
    "export_hands": false,
    "export_body": false,
    "export_paint": false,
    "sam3_prompt": null,
    "export_boxes": true,
    "instance_filter": "all",
    "max_instances": 0,
    "outputs": "[]"
  },
  "engine": "comfyui",
  "form": "form_mask_studio",
  "has_inference": false,
  "has_rubric": false
}
